column3: MT 56:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; the tune name is translated “Set to ‘The Silent Dove in Distant Lands,’” and שְׁאָפַנִי (“trample”) “would swallow me up.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָרוֹם (“on high, proudly”) is taken as the address “O Most High.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV sets “I will praise His word” in parentheses.
Close to the Hebrew; יָגוּרוּ (“they stir up strife”) is rendered “They gather together.”
The line is difficult; NKJV renders it as a question, “Shall they escape by iniquity?” following the Hebrew without the Septuagint negative.
Close to the Hebrew; בְנֹאדֶךָ (“your skin bottle”) is rendered “Your bottle.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV sets the refrain in parentheses, “(I will praise His word).”
Close to the Hebrew; “your vows are upon me” is rendered “Vows made to You are binding upon me,” and “thank offerings” “praises.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Have You not kept,” and “the light of life” is rendered “the light of the living.”
